research_objective: Verify a bounded, non-gradient, provenance-attributed contextual cause/outcome relationship bank can be applied to Yggdrasil's ACTUAL public causal-cell decision path without duplicating observations or altering existing 164-byte checkpoints, and can improve context-specific action selection on a fully public fabricated task without weakening incumbent behavior.

baseline.source_truth: Current main native cell decisions are context-free action/outcome counters; accepted 64-bit quadratic WSP114/115 coefficients do not exist on main.

proposed_delta.bounded_optional_native_ledger: At most 16 addresses, 4 binary contextual variables, 2 action values, 32 unique address/context/action observations per address (512 total); exact deterministic public outcomes only; provenance record for first source of any observation.
proposed_delta.weight_programming: Fit a deterministic GF(2) 10-feature affine+action-context parity function per native address using online row elimination; coefficients materialized as exact float32 0/1 numerical weights; no gradient, transformer, tokens or unseen labels.
proposed_delta.deduplication: Canonical key (native slot,address-context,action) is idempotent. Repeated same public outcome and even a different source label cannot increase learned count, rank, or weights. Conflicting outcome for a canonical key is rejected atomically. No hidden inferred edge written as an observed outcome.
proposed_delta.coefficient_reuse: Share identical programmed ten-synapse vectors among native addresses (dedup same semantic function), but keep distinct address-bound evidence; no merging different semantic relations merely because their content text looks similar.
proposed_delta.integration: Add opt-in PublicCausalCells.choose_contextual(..., relations=...) which uses two exact evidence-supported conditioned predictions only when they disagree; otherwise preserves prior choose(). Never change observe/choose/choose_wilson/snapshot/restore when optional path isn't used. Legacy 164-byte bytes must remain byte-identical.
proposed_delta.retention: Versioned SHA256-protected replayable separate bounded relation checkpoint; no change to existing YPC1 bytes or acceptance schemas; no cross-world or unqualified accepted-model promotion.

frozen_public_fixture.addresses: Seven active plus nine retained, each deterministic public outcome from action choice against parity(context) xor slot parity; train 10 actions/address, score 11 disjoint contexts/address.
frozen_public_fixture.accuracy_metric: 16*11=176 held-out action choices: success probability of selected action under fabricated public deterministic effect; baseline incumbent choose without context uses identical public intervention information; target >=20 percentage-point increase on true outcomes, no regression on baseline public tests.
frozen_public_fixture.safety_metric: The same relationship imported twice, with changed source label, never changes checkpoint or decision; contradictory label outcome rejected atomically; 16 addresses stable; two semantic templates interned; legacy YPC1 checkpoint remains exact 164 bytes; cold restoration predicts identically; missing evidence abstains or uses unchanged baseline.
frozen_public_fixture.claim_limit: DEV fabricated-only mechanism feasibility, NOT evidence of superiority over independent fully trained gradient model or evidence of general intelligence, open-domain associations, cross-world transfer, production use or WSP115 result exploitation.

qualification: Start with fabricated tests Linux+Windows and full root regression; G29 source atlas generated companion exactly 3 .ice files pinned to source SHA, independent G29 + full root both OS on final exact SHA. Any failed metric or drift means no promotion. Original WSP115 v2 science untouched; no rerun, no hidden labels used.

authority.scope: Isolated code proposal, CI qualification, draft PR only. Do not merge, update main, change accepted native learned state, controller, runner, scheduler, Wingless/FORGE/Hybrid, deploy or use live secrets. Promotion needs separately authorized and independently qualified acceptance.
authority.user_intent: Add beneficial nonduplicative knowledge/relationships to Yggdrasil native model, not blindly copy incompatible synthetic experimental weights.
